what: A gradient plate behind the photo (a square 12% wider than the photo cell, 1.1x) rotates once in 24s linearly, so the color of the 8px border around the photo flows slowly. On hover the whole card grows to 1.08x and the plate shrinks to .85x, so the border hides behind the photo (both .4s ease) — on release the border comes back the same way. With look: line there is no hover reaction, and only the plate turns inside a thin 8px-high line, making a line of flowing color (the second line runs backward with --fx-turn: -1turn)

options.[data-fx-part=ring]: Empty child holding the stone panel (as first child) — laid behind the card, and the photo floats by the inner padding (8px) so the border shows
options.--fx-gradient: Board gradient (via style · css), default ink → accent → white → accent text-color conic
options.--fx-base: Board base color (shows at the corners before rotating), default var(--kf-ink)
options.--fx-turn: End angle of the spin, default 1turn — -1turn spins backward (original rotation2)
options.--fx-size · --fx-zoom: Panel size (relative to card width, default 112% · line 100%) · scale (default 1.1)
options.--fx-grow · --fx-shrink: Card scale on hover (default 1.08) · panel scale (default .85)
options.--fx-dur · --fx-ease: Interaction response duration and curve, default .4s ease
options.look: line — thin line with no hover response (height is set by the caller, original 8px)

use: ·

from.where: shared.css .ofk-frame (list, selected post and related post photos) · .ofk-gline (top and bottom lines of the project logo section, second line reversed) — original .gradient-bg img rotation1/2 24s · a:hover scale 1.08 / .gradient-bg .85
